content: Storage adapter behaviour for projections: Orkestra should define Orkestra.Projection.Storage behaviour with callbacks: init_storage/1, write_events/3 (apply a list of {event, multi} transformations), checkpoint_position/2 (read last position), save_checkpoint/3 (persist new position), reset/1 (clear read model for rebuild). Postgres/Ecto adapter wraps Ecto.Multi for transactional writes; MongoDB adapter would use Mongo driver directly (no Ecto); Elasticsearch adapter would use Elastix or httpoison for index writes. The behaviour keeps lifecycle (subscribe/checkpoint/retry/halt) in the shared projector GenServer, and only the write/query side is adapter-specific. This mirrors how Orkestra.EventStore and Orkestra.MessageBus work.
